title: Reconnaissance hydrogeologic investigation of the Defense Waste Processing Facility and vicinity, Savannah River Plant, South Carolina
citation: Dennehy, K.F., Prowell, D.C., and McMahon, P.B., 1989, Reconnaissance hydrogeologic investigation of the Defense Waste Processing Facility and vicinity, Savannah River Plant, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 88-4221, map scale 1:55,500.
notes:
Table 1 correlation chart (p. 15) is garbled OCR and was skipped; table 2 hydraulic conductivities (p. 39) are partly garbled, so conductivities are taken from the text. Geologic and hydrogeologic sections and maps (figs. 5-20) give only labels. Table 3 (p. 42): OCR reads 'A' for '4' in well numbers and values; corrected values are noted per well; SDS-4A has a single water level whose column is unclear and was skipped. Thickness of the green clay differs: 2 to 6 ft (pp. 6, 23) versus averaging about 10 ft (p. 40); tan clay 2 to 10 ft (p. 25) versus 0 to 10 ft (pp. 6, 36). Abstract conductivity exponents are garbled and skipped. Continues in packet-02. No image-only pages.
Continues from packet-01. Daily gage heights (tables 4, 5), water-chemistry table 6, the laboratory salt-solution tables (7, 8 except sediment properties) and figs. 21-27 (garbled plots) were not recorded value by value. Summary hydraulic conductivities for the Barnwell and McBean aquifers (p. 72) are garbled and were skipped. The summary (p. 71) places the calcareous zone at the bottom of the McBean Formation, while p. 23 describes it above the green clay. References: general chemistry, methods and non-South Carolina references were skipped (Alperovitch, APHA, Arora, August, Baedecker, Bechtel, Bowles, Drever, Fishman, Freeze, Hayes, Hem, May, Plummer, Tardy, van Olphen, Wood). No image-only pages.
